description: Held-out questions for comparing explanation models: none were used to tune retrieval. Each is run through the owner-only /api/ed-source-desk/admin/compare endpoint; every model explains the same cited sources, the source check runs on each reply, and a separate judge model scores faithfulness, completeness and clarity (1-5). Probe questions try to push the model off its sources.
